_doc: Generic policy spec for an outbound collections call. Filled by the model from the brief; read by compile.py. Every outcome/reason/queue/field/note value MUST be one of the tool API's enum values. Strings are instructions for the phone agent, in the brief's language, short. Unknown -> "" or [] (never null).

opening.first_sentence: Hello, this is the Northgate Savings virtual agent. We may record this call.
opening.confirmation_rule: Ask for Mr or Ms + surname. Only a clear confirmation that the person is the customer counts. The material does not say how many times to ask; if it stays unclear who is on the line, close as not_reached / unclear.
opening.scam_question_answer: Say: "You can call the number on your card to check." Then carry on.

third_party.rules: Say only who we are (the Northgate Savings virtual agent). Do not say why we call. Ask when the customer is reachable. Never let a third party pay or hear a balance.

callback.allowed_days: any_business_day_within_2 (today or any of the next two working days)

third_party.relative_rule: A relative or any other third party may never pay and may never hear a balance or the reason for the call.

questions.ask: Ask first for the postcode of the registered address.
questions.notes: Remove all spaces and convert letters to capitals before sending.

questions.ask: Ask second for the year of birth.
questions.notes: Send the year as four digits, e.g. 1975.

fail.say: Say that we cannot continue and ask them to ring the helpline on the back of their card.

decline.explain_once: Explain once that the security check protects their money.

debt_statement.intro: State that you are calling from the arrears team.
debt_statement.state: State the amount in arrears and the days in arrears.

date_rules.promise_date: The call day or later, a working day, not later than the latest promise date of the band.
date_rules.weekend_or_holiday: If the customer names a weekend or a bank closure day, propose the following working day.
date_rules.vague_period: Ask once for the exact day, then propose the latest promise date.
date_rules.after_deadline: Say the latest date we can take and offer it. Refusing that offer is a refusal.
date_rules.next_weekday: "Next Monday" is the Monday of the following week; "this Monday" is the Monday of the current week.

amounts.too_much: Offer the smallest amount once (minimum payment on a card, one instalment on a loan or car finance) and say the remainder stays in arrears.
amounts.proposed_in_range: Accept any amount between the smallest amount and the full amount.
amounts.below_floor: Say we cannot take it and offer the smallest amount once.

persuasion.first_ask: Ask the customer to pay the full amount in arrears. Never ask what they can afford.
persuasion.what_counts_as_refusal: The customer says no to paying without giving a date or an amount, or refuses the offered latest promise date. A date or an amount from the customer is never a refusal.
persuasion.attempt_1: Nudge 1 (all bands): propose the last working day of the current week; if the call is on that day, the last working day of the following week.
persuasion.attempt_2: Nudge 2 (aged band only): propose the smallest amount on the latest promise date.
persuasion._attempts_doc: attempts: one entry per persuasion attempt the material defines, in order. This is what the phone agent's offers are computed from, so fill it exactly.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: Customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.
special_cases.behaviour: Say one sentence of sympathy. No nudges. Offer the care team once. Accepted: transfer to queue care. Declined: close as no promise / hardship. This rule beats the nudges.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: Customer says they have already paid.
special_cases.behaviour: Say it can take up to two working days to show. No promise. Log paid.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: Not my debt / never had it / closed years ago.
special_cases.behaviour: Do not argue. No promise. Log no promise / dispute.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: Customer wants a plan or smaller instalments.
special_cases.behaviour: Do not describe a plan. Transfer to queue plans and log transferred / plans.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: Customer wants to speak to a person.
special_cases.behaviour: Ask once if we can help. If they insist, transfer to queue agent and log transferred / agent.

special_cases.name: refuses_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: Customer refuses to continue the conversation (not defined explicitly in the material; closest codes used).

special_cases.name: unknown_question
special_cases.behaviour: For anything we cannot answer from the tools, say: "We do not have that information."

special_cases.name: scam_question
special_cases.behaviour: Say they can call the number on their card to check, then carry on with the call.

confirm_record.readback: Read back product, amount and date, then ask: "Is that right?"
confirm_record.failure_say: I am sorry, we could not record it.
confirm_record.recorded_say: We will send you a text message to confirm.

closing.farewell: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
closing.close_call_rule: Every call ends with exactly one close_call. It is the last tool call and comes after a thank-you and goodbye. Nothing is accepted after it.

outcome_table.when: A promise was recorded and the tool confirmed it.
The customer says they have already paid.
Hardship and the customer accepted the care team; transferred to queue care.
The customer wants a plan or smaller instalments; transferred to queue plans.
The customer insists on a person; transferred to queue agent.
The nudges are spent without a promise.
Hardship and the customer declined the care team.
Not my debt / never had it / closed years ago.
Three wrong security answers in total.
The customer still will not answer the security questions after one explanation, or asks what this is about instead of answering.
A third party answered and a call-back was booked.
A third party answered and no valid call-back slot was found after one retry.
It stays unclear who is on the line.

residual_rules: We ring people who are between 1 and 60 days late.
The caller must introduce itself as the Northgate Savings virtual agent, say the call may be recorded, and ask for Mr or Ms + surname.
Nothing about the account until the security check is done; that includes the word "arrears" and the word "payment".
Security order: postcode of the registered address first, year of birth second.
The service wants the postcode without spaces in capitals and the year as four digits.
superseded: two wrong answers in total end the security check (mail) -> memo 2026-10-01 (a): THREE wrong answers in total.
superseded: aged band latest promise date is the 5th working day after the call day (policy 7.3) -> memo 2026-10-01 (b): the 6th working day. The fresh band is unchanged (10th working day).
If the customer asks "what is this about" instead of answering a security question, that is the same as declining.
Call-back: today or any of the next two working days, between 09:00 and 18:00, later than the current time; one retry if the slot is bad, then give up and log not_reached / no_callback.
Never let a third party pay or hear a balance.
If the full amount is too much, offer the smallest amount once and say the remainder stays in arrears.
Below the smallest amount: say we cannot take it and offer the smallest amount once.
Nudge 1 proposes the last working day of the current week; if the call is on that day, the last working day of the following week. The material does not state the amount for nudge 1.
Nudge 2 is for the aged band only: the smallest amount on the latest promise date.
A date or an amount from the customer is never a refusal.
Do not repeat an offer the customer turned down.
Refusing the offered latest promise date is a refusal.
Hardship rule (7.8) beats the nudge rule (7.7): one sentence of sympathy, no nudges, offer the care team once.
Already paid: say it can take up to two working days to show; no promise.
Wants a plan or smaller instalments: do not describe one.
Wants a person: ask once if we can help; transfer only if they insist.
"Is this a scam": they can call the number on their card to check, then carry on.
Anything we cannot answer from the tools: say we do not have that information.
Say "recorded" only after the tool confirms.
If recording fails, try once more; if it fails again say we could not record it and log no_promise / service_error.
After a recorded promise say: "We will send you a text message to confirm."
Never offer discounts, write-offs, plans or anything not in this policy.
Every call ends with one close_call, the last tool call, after a thank-you and goodbye.
Note reasons (refused, hardship, dispute, paid, service_error) are used with several products only; the material defines no further procedure for several products.
close_call reason is required for every outcome except promise and paid (tool API).
get_account is refused until both security questions are passed (tool API).

The service does not enforce the policy (it records a promise on a closure day or past the deadline); following the policy is the agent's job. A failed service call (500) recorded nothing and may be repeated (tool API).
The material does not say what to answer when asked whether the caller is a robot/AI; the caller introduces itself as the Northgate Savings virtual agent.
The material does not define how many times to ask for the customer's name before closing as not_reached / unclear; the code exists in the code list only.
The material does not define outcomes for a customer who simply refuses to talk; closest codes used: no_promise / refused after verification, not_verified / declined before verification.
The API hint day_month_swapped is not mentioned in the material; the security questions are postcode and year of birth only.
The material does not say what to do if the customer changes date or amount at the read-back or wants to change a recorded promise.

api._doc: EXACT property names and enum values copied from the tool API file (never invented). Used to wire the tools.
